title: Prairie Engine Works
summary: Longlight's biggest game so far. Put an engine together on the test stand, fire it up and hear it run, then take it to the drag strip or a truck and tractor pull to earn cash and reputation.
latest: Race-team seasons in five series, and real recordings as the engine voice

The test screen with the dyno chart ready to run
A finished engine certified as Marginal, with its stress report
The analysis screen listing how the parts you picked interact

title: Lombard
summary: A first-person pawn shop sim on a canal in Mostograd, a made-up Russian river city in the 2010s. Inspect what people bring in, spot the fakes, haggle, and decide how much trouble a good deal is worth.
latest: Playable: the counter loop and the shop economy, with the real art going in

title: Escapement
summary: A watchmaking career game. Build mechanical movements part by part, put them on the timegrapher, chase chronometer certification and sell to collectors, until a shared repair bench in the Haldis becomes a manufacture making its own calibres.
latest: First build: the workshop, the bench and a balance wheel ticking in 3D

title: Station Keeper
summary: A space station tycoon. Build a commercial station module by module and keep it alive, solvent and full of paying guests. Power, cooling, air, crew and money all share one network, so when one thing fails, the rest follow.
latest: Playable: build modules, ride out eclipses, keep the air and the guests happy

title: Season Ticket
summary: A soccer club management game set in Valmere, a made-up northern country. Own a club in the 16-team Kestrel Football League: run the business from your own 3D office, build the squad and the stadium, and change tactics while you watch the match. Play a whole career, on your phone, even offline.
latest: Out now: the first public release, with safer save codes

shots.alt: The manager's office with the laptop showing finances, the desk lamp and the trophy shelf
The lineup screen with a formation on the pitch and the tactics settings beside it
A live 3D match with players around the centre circle and the match stats beside it
The Stadium tab with the 3D ground and the stand upgrade options

title: Frontier Lab
summary: An AI-lab tycoon. Raise a seed round, open sales offices, buy compute or build data centers, train your own models and ship products, keep the safety regulator happy, then take the lab public and grow it across the world's tech capitals, all on an engraved isometric city map.
latest: Model launches, open weights, public tenders and an annual report

title: The Whip
summary: A political career game for your phone. Start as a rookie backbench MP in the 120-seat House of Commons of the made-up Dominion of Caledor and climb to Chief Whip: the person who counts the votes, makes the deals and gets the caucus into the chamber when it matters. Every MP remembers what you promised.
latest: Fully playable: the whole career, from rookie MP to Chief Whip

shots.alt: The division bells ringing in the House, with the bill, the party line and the choice to vote with the party, break with it or be somewhere else
The deal table in the whip's office: what you give an MP on one side and what you get on the other

title: Red Skies
summary: A phone game where you run an air-defence battery. Watch the radar, sort friendly jets from enemies, and hold your fire until you're sure, because shooting down a friendly ends the shift.
latest: Save codes to back up and restore your progress

title: Pre-market brief
summary: Every weekday before the open, a short read on MU, the SOX and the AI hardware names: overnight moves, the gap call, key levels and the day's calendar, written from the morning's news.

title: AI Trading Journal
summary: My market views, the trades I take, and my running record, with notes from an AI coach on what to keep doing and what to fix.

title: Agent Fleet
summary: A set of small, single-purpose bots I can run from my phone, like news digests, trackers, and weekly scans.
latest: Weekly scan and pre-market brief are live
